The 1986–87 edition of the Belgian League was the 84th since its establishment:{{cn|date=November 2025}} it was competed by 18 teams, and [[R.S.C. Anderlecht]] won the championship, while [[R.F.C. Seraing (1904)|RFC Seraing]] and [[K. Berchem Sport]] were relegated.<ref name=Rothmans>{{cite book |title=Rothmans football yearbook 1987-88 |date=1987 |publisher=Queen Anne Press |location=London |isbn=978-0-356-14354-5 |page=835 |url=https://archive.org/details/rothmansfootball00lond/page/834/mode/2up |access-date=24 November 2025}}</ref>
